youtube_description: 睡著學英文！這部影片收錄實用「車子保養」情境對話（每兩句成一組：男聲常速 ➡ 女聲慢速 ➡ 男女連貫）。場景是修車廠：把車開去保養：描述煞車異音、預約時間，師傅頂起車子檢查底盤並報價，決定先修哪幾項、在等候區等零件，取車前試開一圈，最後拿單據問下次保養里程。400 句循環聽，A2 程度，零基礎也能跟著開口說。#英文聽力 #睡前英文 #LearnEnglish
youtube_description_en: Learn English while you sleep! This video features practical 'Taking the Car to the Mechanic' phrase pairs (each pair: male normal speed → female slow speed → combined dialogue). Taking the car in for service: describing a knocking sound, hearing what the mechanic found under the car, agreeing on the work, test-driving it, and asking when to come back. 400 lines on repeat, A2 level, easy to repeat out loud even from zero.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Kevin, your car makes a strange noise.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈkɛvɪn jʊr kɑr meɪks ə streɪndʒ nɔɪz/
dialogue.zh: 凱文，你的車會發出奇怪的聲音。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I know, it started this morning.
dialogue.zh: 我知道，今天早上開始的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: You should call the shop today.
dialogue.zh: 你今天應該打給修車廠。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I'll call them after breakfast.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Did you hear that loud grinding sound?
dialogue.phonetic: /dɪd ju hɪr ðæt laʊd ˈɡraɪndɪŋ saʊnd?/
dialogue.zh: 你有聽到那個很大的摩擦聲嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, it came from the front.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Something is wrong with my car.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Tell me what it sounds like.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can I make an appointment for Saturday?
dialogue.phonetic: /kæn aɪ meɪk ən əˈpɔɪntmənt fɔr ˈsætərˌdeɪ?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Saturday morning at nine thirty works.
dialogue.zh: 星期六早上九點半可以。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My car needs an oil change soon.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪ kɑr nidz ən ɔɪl tʃeɪndʒ sun./
dialogue.zh: 我的車子很快需要換機油。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We can do that on Saturday.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: When I brake, I hear that noise.
dialogue.phonetic: /wɛn aɪ breɪk aɪ hɪr ðæt nɔɪz/
dialogue.zh: 我煞車時就會聽到那個聲音。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then the brake pads are worn.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It also shakes when I stop.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That sounds like warped brake rotors.
dialogue.zh: 聽起來像煞車碟盤變形了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How long can I still drive it?
dialogue.phonetic: /haʊ lɔŋ kæn aɪ stɪl draɪv ɪt?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You should bring it in early.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is it safe to drive until Saturday?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪz ɪt seɪf tu draɪv ʌnˈtɪl ˈsætərˌdeɪ?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It's safe if you drive slowly.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The steering wheel pulls to the right.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə ˈstɪrɪŋ wil pʊlz tu ðə raɪt./

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We can check the alignment too.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: There's a strange smell in my car.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛrz ə streɪndʒ smɛl ɪn maɪ kɑr/
dialogue.zh: 我的車子裡有奇怪的味道。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Maybe the cabin filter is dirty.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Yesterday the engine light came on.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We will read the error code.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: On the highway it feels slow.
dialogue.zh: 在高速公路上感覺很沒力。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That might be a clogged air filter.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt maɪt bi ə klɔɡd ɛr ˈfɪltər./
dialogue.zh: 那可能是空氣濾網堵塞。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can you check the tires as well?
dialogue.phonetic: /kæn ju tʃɛk ðə ˈtaɪərz æz wɛl?/
dialogue.zh: 你也可以順便檢查輪胎嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sure, we check it for free.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The car makes a noise when turning.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə kɑr meɪks ə nɔɪz wɛn ˈtɜrnɪŋ./
dialogue.zh: 車子轉彎時會發出聲音。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That could be a worn bearing.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I smell something burning under the hood.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ smɛl ˈsʌmθɪŋ ˈbɜrnɪŋ ˈʌndər ðə hʊd./
dialogue.zh: 我聞到引擎蓋下有東西燒焦的味道。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It might be a small oil leak.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt maɪt bi ə smɔl ɔɪl lik./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Today the brakes feel soft and weak.
dialogue.phonetic: /təˈdeɪ ðə breɪks fil sɔft ænd wik/
dialogue.zh: 今天煞車感覺軟軟的、沒力。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then we must check the brake fluid.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn wi mʌst tʃɛk ðə breɪk ˈfluɪd./
dialogue.zh: 那我們必須檢查煞車油。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My car is due for regular maintenance.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪ kɑr ɪz du fɔr ˈrɛɡjəlɚ ˈmeɪntənəns./
dialogue.zh: 我的車子該做定期保養了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: How many miles does it have?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It has about eighty thousand miles now.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt hæz əˈbaʊt ˈeɪti ˈθaʊzənd maɪlz naʊ./
dialogue.zh: 現在大約跑了八萬英里。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That's a good time for service.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What time should I drop it off?
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌt taɪm ʃʊd aɪ drɑp ɪt ɔf?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Please arrive before nine thirty.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: By the way, I'm Kevin Lin.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Thanks, Kevin, I wrote it down.
dialogue.zh: 謝謝你，凱文，我記下來了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How much is a basic checkup?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The checkup itself is free.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Please write down my phone number.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I have it in the system now.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ hæv ɪt ɪn ðə ˈsɪstəm naʊ./
dialogue.zh: 我現在已經存進系統了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The noise is getting louder every day.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə nɔɪz ɪz ˈɡɛtɪŋ ˈlaʊdər ˈɛvri deɪ./
dialogue.zh: 那個聲音每天都變得更大聲。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then don't wait until next week.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It stops when I press hard.
dialogue.zh: 我用力踩的時候聲音就停了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That means the brake pads are gone.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt minz ðə breɪk pædz ər ɡɔn./
dialogue.zh: 那表示煞車皮已經沒了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do you hear a clicking sound too?
dialogue.phonetic: /du ju hɪr ə ˈklɪkɪŋ saʊnd tu?/
dialogue.zh: 你也聽到一個咔嗒聲嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, it clicks when I turn left.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs ɪt klɪks wɛn aɪ tɜrn lɛft./
dialogue.zh: 有，我左轉時它會咔嗒響。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My car won't start on cold mornings.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪ kɑr woʊnt stɑrt ɑn koʊld ˈmɔrnɪŋz./
dialogue.zh: 我的車在冷天早上發不動。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Maybe your battery is getting old.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can you check the battery this Saturday?
dialogue.phonetic: /kæn ju tʃɛk ðə ˈbætəri ðɪs ˈsætərˌdeɪ?/
dialogue.zh: 你星期六可以檢查電瓶嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, we test it in one minute.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs wi tɛst ɪt ɪn wʌn ˈmɪnɪt./
dialogue.zh: 可以，我們一分鐘就能測完。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My friend Anna heard the noise too.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪ frɛnd ˈænə hɜrd ðə nɔɪz tu./
dialogue.zh: 我朋友安娜也聽到那個聲音。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Did she say where it came from?
dialogue.phonetic: /dɪd ʃi seɪ wɛr ɪt keɪm frʌm?/
dialogue.zh: 她有說聲音從哪裡來嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Anna said it sounds like metal rubbing.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈænə sɛd ɪt saʊndz laɪk ˈmɛtəl ˈrʌbɪŋ./
dialogue.zh: 安娜說聽起來像金屬摩擦。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: She has a good ear for cars.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃi hæz ə ɡʊd ɪr fɔr kɑrz./
dialogue.zh: 她對車子的聲音很敏銳。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is the repair expensive for old cars?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪz ðə rɪˈpɛr ɪkˈspɛnsɪv fɔr oʊld kɑrz?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It depends on the parts needed.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I need my car back by Monday.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ nid maɪ kɑr bæk baɪ ˈmʌndeɪ./

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We'll try to finish it Saturday.
dialogue.zh: 我們會盡量星期六就完成。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What if you need much more time?
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌt ɪf ju nid mʌtʃ mɔr taɪm?/
dialogue.zh: 如果你需要更多時間怎麼辦？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We'll call you right away then.
dialogue.zh: 那我們會馬上打電話給你。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should I leave my key inside?
dialogue.zh: 我該把鑰匙留在車內嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Please hand the key to Ming.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Who is Ming at your shop?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: He's the head mechanic here.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I'll drive the car there myself.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Drive slowly and avoid hard braking.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is the shop on Main Street?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, it's next to the bank.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How do I get there from here?
dialogue.phonetic: /haʊ du aɪ ɡɛt ðɛr frʌm hɪr?/
dialogue.zh: 我從這裡要怎麼到那裡？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Turn left after the traffic light.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I'm leaving my house right now.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Take your time, we're not busy.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I just parked outside your shop.
dialogue.zh: 我剛把車停在你們店外。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Come inside, I'll be right there.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Good morning, I have an appointment.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Good morning, you must be Kevin.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Yes, and my car is outside.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Let me get the keys from you.
dialogue.phonetic: /lɛt mi ɡɛt ðə kiz frʌm ju./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Here are the keys and the paperwork.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɪr ɑr ðə kiz ænd ðə ˈpeɪpərwɜrk./

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Thanks, I'll park it inside now.
dialogue.zh: 謝謝，我現在把它開進去。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Please listen to that grinding noise.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I'll test drive it in a moment.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪl tɛst draɪv ɪt ɪn ə ˈmoʊmənt./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That noise is worse on the highway.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt nɔɪz ɪz wɜrs ɑn ðə ˈhaɪweɪ./
dialogue.zh: 那個聲音在高速公路上更嚴重。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then I'll take it on the road.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn aɪl teɪk ɪt ɑn ðə roʊd./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can you show me the worn parts?
dialogue.phonetic: /kæn ju ʃoʊ mi ðə wɔrn pɑrts?/
dialogue.zh: 你可以給我看磨損的零件嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Of course, I'll keep the old ones.
dialogue.phonetic: /əv kɔrs aɪl kip ði oʊld wʌnz./
dialogue.zh: 當然，我會把舊的留下來。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How long will the checkup take today?
dialogue.phonetic: /haʊ lɔŋ wɪl ðə ˈtʃɛkʌp teɪk təˈdeɪ?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: About an hour, maybe a bit more.
dialogue.phonetic: /əˈbaʊt ən ˈaʊər ˈmeɪbi ə bɪt mɔr./
dialogue.zh: 大約一小時，也許再多一點。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Where should I wait for the news?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɛr ʃʊd aɪ weɪt fɔr ðə nuz?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The waiting room is over there.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I'll wait and read a magazine.
dialogue.zh: 我在這裡等，順便看雜誌。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I'll come get you when it's done.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪl kʌm ɡɛt ju wɛn ɪts dʌn./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Now the car is on the lift.
dialogue.phonetic: /naʊ ðə kɑr ɪz ɑn ðə lɪft/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I can see the tires hanging.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Please look at the front wheels first.
dialogue.phonetic: /pliz lʊk æt ðə frʌnt wilz fɜrst./

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The front brake pads are very thin.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə frʌnt breɪk pædz ər ˈvɛri θɪn./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How thin are the brake pads?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Only two millimeters, almost gone.
dialogue.zh: 只剩兩公釐，幾乎磨光了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That explains the grinding noise.
dialogue.zh: 這就說明了那個摩擦聲。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, metal is touching metal now.
dialogue.zh: 對，現在是金屬直接磨金屬。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Are the brake rotors damaged as well?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɑr ðə breɪk ˈroʊtərz ˈdæmɪdʒd æz wɛl?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The rotors have deep grooves in them.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə ˈroʊtərz hæv dip ɡruvz ɪn ðɛm./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can you just replace the brake pads?
dialogue.phonetic: /kæn ju dʒʌst rɪˈpleɪs ðə breɪk pædz?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, the rotors must be replaced too.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ ðə ˈroʊtərz mʌst bi rɪˈpleɪst tu./
dialogue.zh: 不行，碟盤也必須一起換。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What about the rear brakes?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: They still have some life left.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Please check the brake fluid too.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The brake fluid is dark and old.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə breɪk ˈfluɪd ɪz dɑrk ænd oʊld./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is dark brake fluid a problem?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, it can damage the system.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Let me show you the worn pads.
dialogue.phonetic: /lɛt mi ʃoʊ ju ðə wɔrn pædz./
dialogue.zh: 我給你看磨損的煞車皮。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Wow, they look really thin.
dialogue.zh: 哇，它們看起來真的很薄。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can I take a photo of that?
dialogue.phonetic: /kæn aɪ teɪk ə ˈfoʊtoʊ əv ðæt?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sure, take as many as you want.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃʊr teɪk æz ˈmɛni æz ju wɑnt./
dialogue.zh: 當然，你想拍幾張就拍幾張。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What is that wet spot down there?
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌt ɪz ðæt wɛt spɑt daʊn ðɛr?/
dialogue.zh: 下面那個濕濕的痕跡是什麼？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That might be a small leak.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Please check where the leak comes from.
dialogue.phonetic: /pliz tʃɛk wɛr ðə lik kʌmz frʌm./
dialogue.zh: 請查一下漏的地方在哪裡。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Give me a minute with the flashlight.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡɪv mi ə ˈmɪnɪt wɪð ðə ˈflæʃlaɪt./
dialogue.zh: 給我一點時間用手電筒照。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is the leak from the engine oil?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪz ðə lik frʌm ði ˈɛndʒɪn ɔɪl?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, the oil pan looks dry.
dialogue.zh: 不是，油底殼看起來是乾的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do you see anything near the front?
dialogue.phonetic: /du ju si ˈɛniˌθɪŋ nɪr ðə frʌnt?/
dialogue.zh: 前面附近你有看到什麼嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The radiator hose looks a little wet.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə ˈreɪdiˌeɪtər hoʊz lʊks ə ˈlɪtəl wɛt./
dialogue.zh: 水箱水管看起來有點濕。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How much for the brake job?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Brake pads and rotors cost twelve thousand.
dialogue.phonetic: /breɪk pædz ænd ˈroʊtərz kɔst twɛlv ˈθaʊzənd./
dialogue.zh: 煞車皮加碟盤要一萬二。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Twelve thousand is a lot for me.
dialogue.phonetic: /twɛlv ˈθaʊzənd ɪz ə lɑt fɔr mi./

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It includes parts and labor, Kevin.
dialogue.zh: 凱文，這包含零件和工資。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Does that price include the labor?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, parts and labor are both included.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs pɑrts ænd ˈleɪbər ɑr boʊθ ɪnˈkludɪd./
dialogue.zh: 有，零件和工資都包含在內。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How long does the brake job take?
dialogue.phonetic: /haʊ lɔŋ dʌz ðə breɪk dʒɑb teɪk?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: About three hours, if parts are here.
dialogue.phonetic: /əˈbaʊt θri ˈaʊərz ɪf pɑrts ɑr hɪr./
dialogue.zh: 如果零件在，大約三小時。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do you have the brake pads here?
dialogue.phonetic: /du ju hæv ðə breɪk pædz hɪr?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, I have them in the back.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs aɪ hæv ðɛm ɪn ðə bæk./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can you finish it before noon?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Probably yes, if nothing else comes up.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈprɑbəbli jɛs ɪf ˈnʌθɪŋ ɛls kʌmz ʌp./
dialogue.zh: 應該可以，如果沒別的問題。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What else could come up today?
dialogue.zh: 今天還可能出現什麼問題？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Old cars often hide small problems.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Please check everything under the car.
dialogue.zh: 請檢查車底所有的地方。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I'm looking at the water pump now.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪm ˈlʊkɪŋ æt ðə ˈwɔtər pʌmp naʊ./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is the water pump in good shape?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪz ðə ˈwɔtər pʌmp ɪn ɡʊd ʃeɪp?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Well, I see red fluid dripping.
dialogue.zh: 嗯，我看到紅色液體在滴。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What does red fluid mean?
dialogue.zh: 紅色液體代表什麼意思？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That's coolant, and it shouldn't leak.
dialogue.zh: 那是冷卻液，它不該漏的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: So the water pump is leaking coolant.
dialogue.phonetic: /soʊ ðə ˈwɔtər pʌmp ɪz ˈlikɪŋ ˈkulənt./
dialogue.zh: 所以水泵浦在漏冷卻液。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, that's the second problem.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is a water pump leak serious?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It can overheat your engine fast.
dialogue.zh: 它會讓引擎很快就過熱。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How much is a new water pump?
dialogue.phonetic: /haʊ mʌtʃ ɪz ə nu ˈwɔtər pʌmp?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The pump costs three thousand five hundred.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə pʌmp kɔsts θri ˈθaʊzənd faɪv ˈhʌndrəd./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: With the brakes, that's the total.
dialogue.zh: 加上煞車，這就是總金額。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That is more than I expected today.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt ɪz mɔr ðæn aɪ ɪkˈspɛktɪd təˈdeɪ./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can we replace the water pump later?
dialogue.phonetic: /kæn wi rɪˈpleɪs ðə ˈwɔtər pʌmp ˈleɪtər?/
dialogue.zh: 我們可以晚點再換水泵浦嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You can, but watch the temperature gauge.
dialogue.phonetic: /ju kæn bʌt wɑtʃ ðə ˈtɛmpərətʃər ɡeɪdʒ./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How long can the water pump wait?
dialogue.phonetic: /haʊ lɔŋ kæn ðə ˈwɔtər pʌmp weɪt?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Not more than two or three weeks.
dialogue.phonetic: /nɑt mɔr ðæn tu ɔr θri wikz./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Will the engine be safe until then?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɪl ði ˈɛndʒɪn bi seɪf ʌnˈtɪl ðɛn?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It should be, if you add coolant.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt ʃʊd bi ɪf ju æd ˈkulənt./
dialogue.zh: 只要補冷卻液，應該沒問題。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can you fix everything in one visit?
dialogue.phonetic: /kæn ju fɪks ˈɛvriˌθɪŋ ɪn wʌn ˈvɪzɪt?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, but I must order the pump.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs bʌt aɪ mʌst ˈɔrdər ðə pʌmp./
dialogue.zh: 可以，但我必須訂水泵浦。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is the water pump in stock?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, it comes Monday morning.
dialogue.zh: 沒有，星期一早上才會到。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: So the car must stay here overnight?
dialogue.phonetic: /soʊ ðə kɑr mʌst steɪ hɪr ˌoʊvərˈnaɪt?/
dialogue.zh: 所以車子必須留在這裡過夜？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, until Monday afternoon, sorry.
dialogue.zh: 是的，要留到星期一下午，抱歉。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What time on Monday can I come?
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌt taɪm ɑn ˈmʌndeɪ kæn aɪ kʌm/
dialogue.zh: 星期一我幾點能過來取車？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Around three, if the pump arrives.
dialogue.zh: 如果水泵浦到了，大約三點。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can I still drive it home today?
dialogue.phonetic: /kæn aɪ stɪl draɪv ɪt hoʊm təˈdeɪ?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Not far, and only with enough coolant.
dialogue.phonetic: /nɑt fɑr ænd ˈoʊnli wɪð ɪˈnʌf ˈkulənt./
dialogue.zh: 不能開遠，而且冷卻液要夠。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is it risky to drive it now?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪz ɪt ˈrɪski tu draɪv ɪt naʊ?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, the engine could get very hot.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs ði ˈɛndʒɪn kʊd ɡɛt ˈvɛri hɑt./
dialogue.zh: 有，引擎可能會變得很燙。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Then I'll leave the car with you.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn aɪl liv ðə kɑr wɪð ju./
dialogue.zh: 那我就把車留在你這裡。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Good choice, we'll start on the brakes.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡʊd tʃɔɪs wil stɑrt ɑn ðə breɪks./
dialogue.zh: 好選擇，我們先從煞車開始。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Please do the brakes first today.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That's what I planned to do.
dialogue.zh: 我本來就是這樣打算的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should I also change the coolant now?
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃʊd aɪ ˈɔlsoʊ tʃeɪndʒ ðə ˈkulənt naʊ?/
dialogue.zh: 我現在也該換冷卻液嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, new coolant comes with the pump.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs nu ˈkulənt kʌmz wɪð ðə pʌmp./
dialogue.zh: 要，新的冷卻液會隨水泵浦一起換。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Does the coolant cost extra money?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, it's included in that price.
dialogue.zh: 不用，已經包含在那個價格裡。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What about the old parts you remove?
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌt əˈbaʊt ði oʊld pɑrts ju rɪˈmuv?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I'll put them in a box.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can I pay with a credit card?
dialogue.phonetic: /kæn aɪ peɪ wɪð ə ˈkrɛdɪt kɑrd?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, we take cards and cash here.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs wi teɪk kɑrdz ænd kæʃ hɪr./
dialogue.zh: 可以，我們收信用卡也收現金。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is there a discount for paying cash?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪz ðɛr ə ˈdɪskaʊnt fɔr ˈpeɪɪŋ kæʃ?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sorry, our prices are already fixed.
dialogue.zh: 抱歉，我們的價格都是固定的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Will you call me before you start?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɪl ju kɔl mi bɪˈfɔr ju stɑrt?/
dialogue.zh: 你開始之前會打給我嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I'll call you this afternoon, Kevin.
dialogue.zh: 凱文，我今天下午會打給你。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My number is on the paperwork, right?
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪ ˈnʌmbər ɪz ɑn ðə ˈpeɪpərwɜrk raɪt?/
dialogue.zh: 我的電話在文件上，對吧？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, I see it right here.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Please keep the car inside tonight.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Don't worry, it sleeps in the garage.
dialogue.phonetic: /doʊnt ˈwɜri ɪt slips ɪn ðə ɡəˈrɑʒ./
dialogue.zh: 別擔心，它會睡在車庫裡。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I feel better leaving it with you.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ fil ˈbɛtər ˈlivɪŋ ɪt wɪð ju./
dialogue.zh: 把車交給你，我比較放心。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We'll take good care of it.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: See you Monday, then, Ming.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: See you Monday, three in the afternoon.
dialogue.phonetic: /si ju ˈmʌndeɪ θri ɪn ði ˌæftərˈnun./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Hello, this is Kevin calling.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Good to hear from you.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How is the car doing today?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The part arrives Monday morning.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Then Monday at three works.
dialogue.zh: 那星期一下午三點可以。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, we will have it ready.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Did you find anything else?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Only the small hose leak.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can you also check the front tires?
dialogue.phonetic: /kæn ju ˈɔlsoʊ tʃɛk ðə frʌnt ˈtaɪərz?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sure, I will look at them.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The tires are only two years old.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə ˈtaɪərz ɑr ˈoʊnli tu jɪrz oʊld/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then they should still be fine.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is the new hose hard to find?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪz ðə nu hoʊz hɑrd tə faɪnd?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, the shop keeps them in stock.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ ðə ʃɑp kips ðɛm ɪn stɑk/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That makes everything much easier.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, we can finish it fast.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should I leave the car keys here?
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃʊd aɪ liv ðə kɑr kiz hɪr?/
dialogue.zh: 我該把車鑰匙留在這裡嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Please leave them at the desk.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do you need my phone number again?
dialogue.phonetic: /du ju nid maɪ foʊn ˈnʌmbər əˈɡɛn?/
dialogue.zh: 你需要我的電話號碼再確認一次嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, we have it on file.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: We can call you when it's done.
dialogue.phonetic: /wi kæn kɔl ju wɛn ɪts dʌn/
dialogue.zh: 好了我們可以打電話給你。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Please call before the shop closes.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: One more thing about the small leak.
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌn mɔr θɪŋ əˈbaʊt ðə smɔl lik/
dialogue.zh: 關於那個小漏，還有一件事。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Go on, I am listening carefully.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Could the leak have damaged something else?
dialogue.phonetic: /kʊd ðə lik hæv ˈdæmɪdʒd ˈsʌmθɪŋ ɛls?/
dialogue.zh: 這個漏會不會弄壞別的東西？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Not yet, but it needs attention.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Then please fix it right away.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, it is first on my list.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs ɪt ɪz fɜrst ɑn maɪ lɪst/
dialogue.zh: 好，它是我清單上的第一項。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Does the hose cost a lot?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It is small and rather cheap.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The trouble is finding the right one.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə ˈtrʌbəl ɪz ˈfaɪndɪŋ ðə raɪt wʌn/
dialogue.zh: 麻煩的是要找到對的那條。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Right, and it must fit exactly.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I trust you to pick good parts.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ trʌst ju tə pɪk ɡʊd pɑrts/
dialogue.zh: 我相信你會挑好的零件。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We only use parts that last.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What else needs work on the car?
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌt ɛls nidz wɜrk ɑn ðə kɑr?/
dialogue.zh: 車子還有什麼地方要處理？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The rear brakes are still fine.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I don't have much money this month.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ doʊnt hæv mʌtʃ ˈmʌni ðɪs mʌnθ/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then we will only do the front.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn wi wɪl ˈoʊnli du ðə frʌnt/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Good, the front brakes are done.
dialogue.zh: 好，前煞車已經處理好了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then the car is nearly ready.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What will the final bill look like?
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌt wɪl ðə ˈfaɪnəl bɪl lʊk laɪk?/
dialogue.zh: 那最後的帳單大概會是多少？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I will write everything down clearly.
dialogue.zh: 我會把每一項都寫清楚。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Don't forget the small parts, please.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Don't worry, nothing is extra.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Are the new parts under some warranty?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɑr ðə nu pɑrts ˈʌndər sʌm ˈwɔrənti?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, for a whole year.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Will you take it for a drive?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɪl ju teɪk ɪt fɔr ə draɪv?/
dialogue.zh: 你們會把它開出去試嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Of course, we test every repair.
dialogue.zh: 當然，每次修理我們都會試。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Then I will wait for your call.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn aɪ wɪl weɪt fɔr jʊr kɔl/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We will call you on Monday.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How long do we wait now?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The shop ordered it on Saturday.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Where does the part come from?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It comes from a shop downtown.
dialogue.zh: 從市中心的一家店送來。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do you have a place to sit?
dialogue.phonetic: /du ju hæv ə pleɪs tə sɪt?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sure, the waiting room is right there.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃʊr ðə ˈweɪtɪŋ rum ɪz raɪt ðɛr/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is there coffee in the waiting room?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪz ðɛr ˈkɔfi ɪn ðə ˈweɪtɪŋ rum?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, and some tea as well.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can I have a cup of coffee?
dialogue.phonetic: /kæn aɪ hæv ə kʌp əv ˈkɔfi?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Help yourself, the pot is full.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Where are the cups and the sugar?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɛr ɑr ðə kʌps ənd ðə ˈʃʊɡər?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: They are on the small table.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: We might be here a long while.
dialogue.phonetic: /wi maɪt bi hɪr ə lɔŋ waɪl/
dialogue.zh: 我們可能要在這裡待上一段時間。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, it arrives Monday morning.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What can we do until then?
dialogue.zh: 在那之前我們能做什麼？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: There are magazines on the shelf.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Reading sounds better than watching the clock.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈridɪŋ saʊndz ˈbɛtər ðæn ˈwɑtʃɪŋ ðə klɑk/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That is true for most people.
dialogue.zh: 對大多數人來說確實如此。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is there anything to eat here?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Just some donuts in that box.
dialogue.zh: 只有那個盒子裡的甜甜圈。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Who brought the donuts this time?
dialogue.zh: 這次的甜甜圈是誰帶來的？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The mechanic bought them for everyone.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That was kind of him.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: He does that almost every week.
dialogue.zh: 他幾乎每個星期都這樣做。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do you work here or just wait?
dialogue.phonetic: /du ju wɜrk hɪr ɔr dʒʌst weɪt?/
dialogue.zh: 你是在這裡工作還是只是在等？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I am waiting for my car too.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ æm ˈweɪtɪŋ fɔr maɪ kɑr tu/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What is wrong with your car?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The engine makes a strange noise.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Our cars both make odd noises.
dialogue.zh: 我們的車都發出奇怪的聲音。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Maybe this shop is very busy.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: This place is busier than I thought.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɪs pleɪs ɪz ˈbɪziər ðæn aɪ θɔt/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Only when something sounds wrong.
dialogue.zh: 只在有東西聽起來不對的時候。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: This coffee here is quite good.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It is better than the garage smell.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt ɪz ˈbɛtər ðæn ðə ɡəˈrɑʒ smɛl/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can you hear the tools from here?
dialogue.phonetic: /kæn ju hɪr ðə tulz frʌm hɪr?/
dialogue.zh: 你從這裡聽得到工具的聲音嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, someone is working nearby.
dialogue.zh: 聽得到，有人在附近工作。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That noise means my car is open.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt nɔɪz minz maɪ kɑr ɪz ˈoʊpən/
dialogue.zh: 那個聲音表示我的車正在被拆。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: They work fast on every car.
dialogue.zh: 他們每台車都處理得很快。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should we ask for an update?
dialogue.zh: 我們該去問一下進度嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Let's wait a little longer first.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My coffee is getting cold already.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then pour yourself a fresh cup.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do you want another cup too?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, one cup is enough for me.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ wʌn kʌp ɪz ɪˈnʌf fɔr mi/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That was a long wait today.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Good thing we brought a book.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: At last, the mechanic is calling us.
dialogue.phonetic: /æt læst ðə məˈkænɪk ɪz ˈkɔlɪŋ ʌs/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Let's go and hear the news.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Did the new part finally arrive?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, and the car is almost done.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs ənd ðə kɑr ɪz ˈɔlmoʊst dʌn/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is my car ready to pick up?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪz maɪ kɑr ˈrɛdi tə pɪk ʌp?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, it is parked out front.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Did you try driving it after?
dialogue.zh: 修好之後你試開過了嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We drove it around the block.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Would you take me for a drive?
dialogue.phonetic: /wʊd ju teɪk mi fɔr ə draɪv?/
dialogue.zh: 你可以帶我試開一下嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sure, let's go right now.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The engine sounds much quieter now.
dialogue.zh: 引擎現在聽起來安靜多了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The new hose fixed that noise.
dialogue.zh: 新管子解決了那個聲音。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I don't hear the rattle anymore.
dialogue.zh: 我再也聽不到那個喀噠聲了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That means the work was good.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How does the brake pedal feel?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It feels firm and safe.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Let's drive slowly down this street.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Take your time, there is no rush.
dialogue.phonetic: /teɪk jʊr taɪm ðɛr ɪz noʊ rʌʃ/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The steering wheel turns very smoothly.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Everything under the car is tight.
dialogue.zh: 車底下的每個地方都鎖緊了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do you hear anything strange still?
dialogue.zh: 你還聽到任何奇怪的聲音嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, the car runs very well.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That is a real relief for me.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt ɪz ə ril rɪˈlif fɔr mi/
dialogue.zh: 這真的讓我鬆了一口氣。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You worried about it all week.
dialogue.zh: 你為這件事擔心了一整個星期。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can we drive back to the shop?
dialogue.phonetic: /kæn wi draɪv bæk tə ðə ʃɑp?/
dialogue.zh: 我們可以開回店裡了嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, the test drive is finished.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The car feels solid on the road.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə kɑr filz ˈsɑlɪd ɑn ðə roʊd/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That is how it should feel.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What do I owe for all this?
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌt du aɪ oʊ fɔr ɔl ðɪs?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The total is on this paper.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is a card okay here?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, we take cards at the desk.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs wi teɪk kɑrdz æt ðə dɛsk/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Here is my card, please be careful.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɪr ɪz maɪ kɑrd pliz bi ˈkɛrfəl/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Thank you, this will take a second.
dialogue.phonetic: /θæŋk ju ðɪs wɪl teɪk ə ˈsɛkənd/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Could I get a copy?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Of course, I will print one now.
dialogue.phonetic: /əv kɔrs aɪ wɪl prɪnt wʌn naʊ/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Does this paper show the warranty?
dialogue.zh: 這張紙上有保固資訊嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, the bottom line explains everything.
dialogue.zh: 有，最下面那行都寫清楚了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Please keep this receipt in your car.
dialogue.phonetic: /pliz kip ðɪs rɪˈsit ɪn jʊr kɑr/
dialogue.zh: 請把這張收據放在車上。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I will put it in the glovebox.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ wɪl pʊt ɪt ɪn ðə ˈɡlʌvˌbɑks/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Did the shop use the right oil?
dialogue.phonetic: /dɪd ðə ʃɑp juz ðə raɪt ɔɪl?/
dialogue.zh: 店裡用的是對的機油嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, the same kind as before.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The bill is lower than I feared.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə bɪl ɪz ˈloʊər ðæn aɪ fɪrd/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We only charged for real work.
dialogue.zh: 我們只收真正做過的工作。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: You fixed the leak very quickly.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We had the part in stock.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can we drive it home now?
dialogue.zh: 我們現在可以開回家了嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, the car is all yours.
dialogue.zh: 可以，車子完全是你的了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It feels good to drive it again.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt filz ɡʊd tə draɪv ɪt əˈɡɛn/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Drive safely and enjoy the quiet.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Before we go, one last question.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ask me anything about the car.
dialogue.zh: 關於車子的事都可以問我。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: When should I bring it back again?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɛn ʃʊd aɪ brɪŋ ɪt bæk əˈɡɛn?/
dialogue.zh: 我什麼時候該再把它開來？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Come back after five thousand miles.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do I need to come back soon?
dialogue.phonetic: /du aɪ nid tə kʌm bæk sun?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Only when the oil needs changing.
dialogue.zh: 只有機油需要換的時候。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How many miles until the next service?
dialogue.phonetic: /haʊ ˈmɛni maɪlz ʌnˈtɪl ðə nɛkst ˈsɜrvəs?/
dialogue.zh: 距離下次保養還有多少英里？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: About five thousand miles from today.
dialogue.zh: 從今天算大約五千英里。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That sounds like a long time.
dialogue.zh: 聽起來是一段很長的時間。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: For you, that is maybe six months.
dialogue.phonetic: /fɔr ju ðæt ɪz ˈmeɪbi sɪks mʌnθs/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should I check the oil myself sometimes?
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃʊd aɪ tʃɛk ðə ɔɪl maɪˈsɛlf ˈsʌmˌtaɪmz?/
dialogue.zh: 我該偶爾自己檢查機油嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, once a month is plenty.
dialogue.zh: 要，一個月一次就很夠了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What if a warning light comes on?
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌt ɪf ə ˈwɔrnɪŋ laɪt kʌmz ɑn?/
dialogue.zh: 如果警示燈亮起來怎麼辦？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Stop the car and call us.
dialogue.zh: 把車停下來，打電話給我們。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Will you remember my car next time?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɪl ju rɪˈmɛmbər maɪ kɑr nɛkst taɪm?/
dialogue.zh: 下次你還記得我的車嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, your name is in our book.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs jʊr neɪm ɪz ɪn aʊər bʊk/
dialogue.zh: 記得，你的名字在我們的紀錄裡。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Finally it feels like my car again.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈfaɪnəli ɪt filz laɪk maɪ kɑr əˈɡɛn/
dialogue.zh: 車子終於又像是我的車了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A good repair does feel that way.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə ɡʊd rɪˈpɛr dʌz fil ðæt weɪ/
dialogue.zh: 修得好確實會有這種感覺。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I was nervous about the whole thing.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ wʌz ˈnɜrvəs əˈbaʊt ðə hoʊl θɪŋ/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Most drivers feel the same way.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: At least it wasn't the engine.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Right, the engine is still strong.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: So the car is safe for winter.
dialogue.phonetic: /soʊ ðə kɑr ɪz seɪf fɔr ˈwɪntər/
dialogue.zh: 所以車子過冬沒問題了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, and the heater works fine.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: You saved me a lot of trouble.
dialogue.phonetic: /ju seɪvd mi ə lɑt əv ˈtrʌbəl/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That is our job every day.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My friends will hear about this shop.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪ frɛndz wɪl hɪr əˈbaʊt ðɪs ʃɑp/
dialogue.zh: 我會跟朋友推薦這家店。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We always welcome new customers.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: One more look at the new hose?
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌn mɔr lʊk æt ðə nu hoʊz?/
dialogue.zh: 再看一眼那條新管子好嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sure, it is right under here.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It looks clean and very new.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Give it a light touch.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That small part caused all this worry.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt smɔl pɑrt kɔzd ɔl ðɪs ˈwɜri/
dialogue.zh: 那個小零件引起了這一切擔心。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Small parts often cause big problems.
dialogue.zh: 小零件常常造成大問題。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Next time I will come earlier.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Come before the morning rush starts.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can I park here for a minute?
dialogue.phonetic: /kæn aɪ pɑrk hɪr fɔr ə ˈmɪnɪt/
dialogue.zh: 我可以在這裡停一下車嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sure, the front row is free.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Please write the mileage on the sticker.
dialogue.phonetic: /pliz raɪt ðə ˈmaɪlɪdʒ ɑn ðə ˈstɪkər/
dialogue.zh: 請把里程數寫在貼紙上。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Done, it is on the windshield.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The mechanic also gave some good news.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə məˈkænɪk ˈɔlsoʊ ɡeɪv sʌm ɡʊd nuz/
dialogue.zh: 師傅還帶來了個好消息。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: He said the car is safe now.
dialogue.phonetic: /hi sɛd ðə kɑr ɪz seɪf naʊ/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: So the brakes and pump are done.
dialogue.phonetic: /soʊ ðə breɪks ænd pʌmp ər dʌn/
dialogue.zh: 所以煞車和水泵都處理好了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, and the total was fair.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The car is finally quiet and safe.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə kɑr ɪz ˈfaɪnəli ˈkwaɪət ənd seɪf/
dialogue.zh: 車子終於又安靜又安全。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That is the best feeling today.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Want to sit in the car first?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɑnt tu sɪt ɪn ðə kɑr fɜrst/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Not now, we will walk home.
dialogue.zh: 現在不用，我們要走回家。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can I call if it rattles again?
dialogue.phonetic: /kæn aɪ kɔl ɪf ɪt ˈrætəlz əˈɡɛn?/
dialogue.zh: 如果它又發出喀噠聲，我可以打來嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Please call, the warranty covers it.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: So we are all set then.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, your car is in good shape.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs jʊr kɑr ɪz ɪn ɡʊd ʃeɪp/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What a long week with this car.
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌt ə lɔŋ wik wɪð ðɪs kɑr/
dialogue.zh: 這台車讓這一週過得很漫長。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Now you can just enjoy driving.
dialogue.zh: 現在你只要好好享受開車就好。

issues.note: 本輪視圖無音標列，此維完全依機器證據給分：audit_script.py hard=0（IPA 形狀與逐詞對齊通過）、ipa_vote.py 全庫 SUSPECT 0，故給滿分 25。

具名保留（非 error，全篇最易絆到聽眾的一處）：342-345「Can we drive it home now?／Yes, the car is all yours.／Drive safely…」與 399「Now you can just enjoy driving.」都是開車回家，而 392-393「Want to sit in the car first?／Not now, we will walk home.」若把 char_b 固定當 Kevin 才互斥；依 vbrief 第 12 行聲位豁免，讀成同行友人不搭車、自己步行回家即通順，內容亦非答非所問，故不判 error，但建議下次順修一句。
具名保留（非 error）：385 仍是店員聲位（Done, it is on the windshield.），386-387 立刻以第三人稱談 the mechanic／He said the car is safe now.；靠 274-295 已建立的同行顧客聲位切換可解，vbrief 明示聲位切換不算缺陷，且無「同一聲位扮店員又第三人稱談店員」的情形。
具名保留（非 error）：86-88 已交鑰匙與文件、代客停車進廠，216-217 又問「要不要把鑰匙留在這裡」；可讀成留備用鑰匙或電話中的交代，屬重述而非硬矛盾。
具名保留（非 error）：97-99 已在等候室看雜誌，254-255 又問「有沒有地方坐」，同一場地資訊重述一次；不影響成對邏輯。
具名保留（非 error）：24-25 車內異味（cabin filter）、54-57 冷天難發動（battery）未被 207「Only the small hose leak.」回報結果；兩者是未收費的附加檢查，主線（前來令片＋碟盤、水泵＋冷卻液、散熱水管）與 388「brakes and pump are done」一致，故不扣為 error。

輕微語感（29 已修好，「we check it for free」通順可過）：57「Yes, we test it in one minute.」用現在簡單式表本次服務，母語者多說 we can test it in a minute；244「Are the new parts under some warranty?」用 under 稍硬，口語多說 Is there a warranty on the new parts?。其餘口語自然，無超綱詞（warped rotors／alignment／coolant／temperature gauge 屬主題必要名詞）。

近似重複：255「Sure, the waiting room is right there.」對 96「The waiting room is over there.」；327「Yes, we take cards at the desk.」對 187「Yes, we take cards and cash here.」；機器已驗無整句重複，且 176-178 僅一對重申「先做剎車」，故只小扣。

review.summary_zh: 本輪獨立複核最終文本：上一輪點名的 29 措辭已修（現為「Sure, we check it for free.」，通順可過），剎車（來令片 2 公釐／碟盤深溝／煞車油變黑）、水泵紅液與散熱水管、12,000＋3,500 報價、八萬英里與五千英里保養間隔、週六送修到週一下午三點取車的時間線，全篇前後一致，未發現任何 error 級問題；C 項音標依機器證據（hard=0、SUSPECT 0、逐詞對齊通過）給滿分。僅存 392-393「walk home」、386-387 第三人稱轉述、216-217 鑰匙重述、255／327 近似重複等小瑕，已逐條具名並合理化，故判 APPROVED（94）。
